base: append_rows(canonical CSR, row bounds, sealed full_row_ids)
updated: reload_updated(...) performs strict-kOk clearModel on the same native Highs instance

contract.request_lifecycle: base load/solve -> clearModel -> optional updated load/solve -> clear
contract.base_infeasible_calls: getDualRayExist exactly once and true, then getDualRay exactly once and true
contract.upper_only_ray: shape matches solver row order, finite, every value <= 0, at least one stored-binary64 exact nonzero
contract.row_mapping: full phase-row ids are copied, sealed, hashed, and bound to append order before native addRows
contract.CSR: exact int32 indptr/indices, float64 data, canonical strictly increasing rows, no duplicates, no explicit zeros, finite, and abs(data) < 1e15
contract.tiny_matrix_rule: delete only 0 < abs(a) <= 1e-12 explicitly and outward-project row bounds
contract.tiny_upper_formula: U - exact Fraction sum(min(a*l,a*u)), rounded toward +inf
contract.tiny_lower_formula: L - exact Fraction sum(max(a*l,a*u)), rounded toward -inf
contract.tiny_objective_rule: 0 < abs(c) <= 1e-12 fails closed; objective coefficients are never deleted
contract.per_load_postcondition: exact cumulative column, row, and nnz counts
contract.any_non_kOk: POISONED; no retry or readback; clear and discard
contract.deadline: checked before and after run/readback and before/after dual-ray retrieval; late results are discarded
contract.cleanup: BaseException primary identity wins; hostile cleanup __str__/__repr is never called; cleanup failure is a secondary note
